public_rationale: On May 14, 2026, AppleInsider reported that OpenAI's internal studies found users preferred the standalone ChatGPT app over Apple's integration. [e1] The report supplies neither an integration-specific user count establishing adoption by hundreds of millions nor attributable compute and energy costs. [e1] Its account of financial disappointment therefore does not settle the cost prediction at the stated adoption scale. [e1]
limitations: The cited report summarizes internal studies without providing their underlying measurements.
Preference for the standalone app does not establish or exclude integration adoption by hundreds of millions.
No matching integration-specific usage and serving-cost records are supplied.
The claim specifies neither a deadline nor a numerical threshold for substantial expenditure.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If the ChatGPT integration actually sees adoption by Apple's hundreds of millions of users, it will cost OpenAI an incredible amount of money because ChatGPT is compute- and energy-intensive.
conditions: in the event that this integration actually sees adoption by Apple's hundreds of millions of users

statement.excerpt: In the event that this integration actually sees adoption by Apple’s hundreds of millions of users, it will cost OpenAI an incredible amount of money thanks to the compute and energy-intensive nature of ChatGPT, especially as I imagine most users will only ask it the occasional question and find no reason to opt for a $20-a-month subscription.

from_speaker: In the event that this integration actually sees adoption
Apple’s hundreds of millions of users
cost OpenAI an incredible amount of money
compute and energy-intensive nature of ChatGPT
our_interpretation: The condition requires actual use of the Apple integration by hundreds of millions of people, not merely access on that many devices.
The ordinary reading of an incredible amount is substantial aggregate serving expenditure. No numerical dollar threshold is supplied or invented.
The claim concerns gross costs attributable to this usage, not OpenAI's total losses or the deal's net profitability.
The surrounding press-based discussion makes this an estimated cost prediction.
criteria.support_condition: After adoption by hundreds of millions is established, reliable evidence shows substantial attributable compute and energy costs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After that adoption is established, reliable evidence shows that the attributable compute and energy costs are small.

evidence.excerpt: users overwhelmingly preferred the standalone ChatGPT app
evidence.locator: Apple kept ChatGPT available, but tightly controlled
evidence.explanation: This report summarizes Bloomberg's account of internal studies. It cautions against treating standalone ChatGPT adoption as integration adoption, but supplies no count establishing or excluding hundreds of millions.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Verified integration-specific unique-user counts establishing adoption by hundreds of millions, paired with cost records or well-supported estimates for the same period showing whether attributable compute and energy expenditure was substantial or small.
